preconditions.description: The number of steps n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'UD' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have a length equal to n and consist only of characters 'U' and 'D'.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(duration, int) for duration in output)
postconditions.description: Each duration in the output must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(duration >= 0 or duration == -1 for duration in output)
postconditions.description: Each duration must be either a non-negative integer or -1.
The output must contain exactly n integers.
